findings.title: Undefined no-argument isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() call
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments. The changed sources only add protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) in UsernamePasswordForm and do not define a no-argument method in UsernameForm, UsernamePasswordForm, or AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator. As written this will not compile; use the new overload, for example isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), or add the missing no-arg helper.

findings.title: Passkey conditional UI is no longer initialized for unauthenticated first login
findings.body: authenticate() now calls webauthnAuth.fillContextForm only when isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()) is true, and that helper returns false when the user is null. The previous code explicitly filled the WebAuthn context in the user==null branch, so the initial login page, and error pages before a user is identified via the challenge override at line 137, no longer receive the WebAuthn challenge and conditional-UI attributes. This breaks first-time passkey/discoverable-credential login and contradicts the updated tests that expect the webauthn form on the initial login page.
